verdict.rationale: Semgrep is a static-analysis/security-scanning tool, not an AI agent or orchestrator that would consume other MCP servers' tools; the only MCP-related evidence shows Semgrep exposing its own MCP server for other agents to use (the reverse direction), which is a separate story. Acting as an MCP client to plug in and use other servers' tools is not a fair capability question for this product category.
